# OpenRAC's changes to rac2-decomp

Applied to [rac2-decomp](https://github.com/OpenRAC/rac2-decomp) (`games/rac2/decomp`) by `python3 tools/sources.py apply`; how to change them: [docs/SOURCES.md](../../../docs/SOURCES.md).

| [0002-sound-slot-limit.patch](0002-sound-slot-limit.patch) | Stop at the last of the 52 sound channel slots. |
| [0003-effect-colour.patch](0003-effect-colour.patch) | Set a new effect record's colour before its first draw. |
